propositions: Acceptance criteria that merely restate generic development-process gates enforced mechanically by CI/rebar for every ticket add no signal and waste completion-verifier effort; a new plan-review criterion is needed to flag such redundant gates at plan time.

The ac-process-gate criterion must discriminate between generic, ticket-agnostic process gates (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint pass, plan-review passes, merged/landed, DCO present) and ticket-specific deliverable ACs (e.g. tests covering a named feature, updated criteria to a named rubric).

The criterion is registered as a non-code-grounded, single-turn advisory plan-review criterion in CANONICAL_LLM, with routing entry in criteria_routing.json, facet ac-text-quality, and container+leaf scope.
The rubric prompt enumerates the reject-set and accept-set, applies the litmus "reads identically on an arbitrary unrelated ticket", and enforces an err-toward-silence anti-false-positive rule.

Deterministic unit tests pin registration, routing checklist (gate-not-applicable PASS + judgment per AC), front-matter contract, guide section presence, eval-spec shape (≥2 fire, ≥2 no-fire, ≤8 cases), and absence from effectiveness-recorder auto-inclusion.

Live bounded-sanity eval on the committed corpus achieves recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0, firing on process-gate ACs (children-closed; tests/CI+plan-review pass) and passing deliverable ACs (E2E tests for named feature; plan-review criteria updated to rubric).
